objective.text: Retain both accepted and rejected items through partition without rerunning a changing predicate.

difficulty.rationale: Classify each input once while retaining both groups.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A predicate performs a time-sensitive check. The code needs both accepted and rejected items, with each item checked exactly once. Which collection operation fits?

options.text: filter($predicate) and use the same filtered collection for rejected items.
options.rationale: That loses the rejected set and mislabels the accepted items.
options.misconception: That loses the rejected set and mislabels the accepted items.

options.text: filter($predicate) followed by reject($predicate) on the original collection.
options.rationale: That evaluates the predicate twice per item and can observe different time-sensitive results.
options.misconception: That evaluates the predicate twice per item and can observe different time-sensitive results.

options.text: partition($predicate), yielding the passing and failing collections together.
options.rationale: partition classifies each item in one pass and retains both outcomes.

options.text: map($predicate) and use the resulting booleans as both item groups.
options.rationale: That replaces the items with boolean results rather than retaining the requested groups.
options.misconception: That replaces the items with boolean results rather than retaining the requested groups.
